House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; 2026 SPECIAL OLYMPICS USA GAMES. +]

[+$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games to celebrate the arts and cultural heritage of Minnesota during Special Olympics events, including through design and construction of the Special Olympics Cauldron. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; 2026 SPECIAL OLYMPICS USA GAMES.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games to celebrate the arts and cultural heritage of Minnesota during Special Olympics events, including through design and construction of the Special Olympics Cauldron.
additions: $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games to celebrate the arts and cultural heritage of Minnesota during Special Olympics events, including through design and construction of the Special Olympics Cauldron.
